parameters.name: DataDisk
parameters.description: The information about data disk types.

sub_parameters.name: Category
sub_parameters.description:
The category of the data disk. Specify this parameter when you want to query the price of new subscription data disks to be attached to the ECS instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 16. Valid values:

- cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
- cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
- cloud_essd: enterprise SSD.
- cloud: basic disk.

Default value: null.

> The instance type parameter (`InstanceType`) and data disk parameters (`DataDisk.N.*`) cannot both be empty. You must specify at least one.

sub_parameters.name: PerformanceLevel
sub_parameters.description:
The performance level of the data disk when the data disk is an enterprise SSD. The value of N must be the same as that in `DataDisk.N.Category=cloud_essd`. Valid values:

- PL0: a single disk can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
- PL1: a single disk can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
- PL2: a single disk can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
- PL3: a single disk can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS.

Default value: PL1.

For information about how to select an ESSD performance level, see [ESSD](~~122389~~).

sub_parameters.name: Size
sub_parameters.description:
The capacity of the data disk. Valid values of N: 1 to 16. Unit: GiB. Valid values:

- cloud_efficiency: 20 to 32768.
- cloud_ssd: 20 to 32768.
- cloud_essd: The valid values depend on the value of `DataDisk.N.PerformanceLevel`.    
    - PL0: 1 to 32768.
    - PL1: 20 to 32768.
    - PL2: 461 to 32768.
    - PL3: 1261 to 32768.
- cloud: 5 to 2000.

Default value: the minimum capacity for the specified data disk category.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the instance for which you want to query the upgrade price.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The target instance type for the upgrade. Call [DescribeResourcesModification](~~66187~~) to query the instance types available for upgrade in a specified zone.

> The instance type parameter (`InstanceType`) and data disk parameters (`DataDisk.N.*`) cannot both be empty. You must specify at least one.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: SystemDisk.Category
parameters.description:
The category of the system disk. You need to specify this parameter only when you upgrade from a retired instance type to an available instance type and upgrade a non-I/O optimized instance to an I/O optimized instance. For more information about instance types, see [Instance family](~~25378~~) and [Retired instance types](~~55263~~).

Valid values:

- cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
- cloud_ssd: standard SSD.

Default value: null.
